title: Release A Slice 1 Platform-Keyed Context Capsule
description: Supplemental lane-local context/provenance record keyed to a platform task/lane identity. Platform task tools remain canonical for live subject/status/dependencies/owner truth when present; this capsule may snapshot those fields only as freshness/evidence inputs. The stdlib validator in tests/lanes/validate_context_capsules.py enforces semantic invariants that JSON Schema cannot express portably.

canonical_snapshot.description: Freshness/evidence snapshot only; consumers must re-read platform task state for live truth when task tools are present.
